# Code of conduct

Be respectful, constructive, and considerate in issues, reviews, and other project spaces. Critique the work, acknowledge different experience levels, and keep discussion relevant. Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexual content, and publishing private information are unacceptable.

Report conduct concerns privately to [support@anhedral.com](mailto:support@anhedral.com). Do not put private information in public reports. Maintainers may edit or remove content, close discussions, or restrict participation to protect the project and its contributors. Enforcement decisions are made by the maintainer, with confidentiality respected where possible.
